title: Views counter: schema migration + RPC + frontend integration
acceptance_criteria: Schema: `ALTER TABLE forum_topics ADD COLUMN view_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0` via supabase_apply_migration
RPC function `increment_topic_view(topic_id UUID)`: increments view_count by 1, uses session-based dedup (checks a `topic_views` helper table or cookie/sessionStorage on frontend)
Dedup: same user session only counts once per topic view (use sessionStorage key `viewed_${topicId}`)
RPC called on ForumTopicPage mount via useEffect — calls supabase.rpc('increment_topic_view', { topic_id })
ForumTopicPage: views stat in CommunityHeader uses topic.view_count from DB (not computed from posts.length)
Updated ForumTopic interface in types/index.ts to include view_count
deliverables: Supabase migration: add view_count to forum_topics
Supabase migration: create increment_topic_view RPC function
